lessons.title: Moisture, drying and folding

notes.title: Word usage
notes.pattern: Nが湿っています / Nを乾かします / VてからV
notes.explanation: 湿る describes something becoming damp; 乾かす means dry something. 乾燥 names dryness or drying. 湿度 is the measured humidity; 湿気 moisture in the air. 蒸し暑い is muggy and hot. たたむ means fold. かかる here takes time or money; it is a different dictionary identity from the homophone meaning catch a disease.

notes.title: How long it takes
notes.pattern: Vるのに + time / money + かかる
notes.explanation: の turns the action into a noun-like phrase; に links it to the time or money needed. 洗うのに三時間かかりました means washing took three hours. This is not the concessive のに meaning although.

notes.title: Grammar in this lesson
notes.explanation: Replace the final い with くて to connect an い-adjective to another description or give a related reason. いい uses よくて.

lessons.title: Explaining a repair

notes.title: Grammar in this lesson
notes.pattern: Nが取れます / Nを外します / Nが付いています
notes.explanation: 修繕 is repair work. 釘 is a nail and ネジ a screw. 取れる describes something coming off; 外す taking it off deliberately; 付く being attached. 切れる means a line or connection breaks. ずれる shifts out of position; 動かす moves something deliberately. 針金 is metal wire and ボタン a clothing or device button. For without doing, replace the plain negative ない with ずに: 使わない → 使わずに. する becomes せずに; verb stem + そう describes what looks likely to happen, as in 取れそう.

notes.title: Grammar in this lesson
